svg.aria-label: Daily doodle for September 24, 2026 — the 90th anniversary of the birth of Jim Henson on September 24, 1936. On the left half, a small stage with a red curtain valance across the top and four abstract felt puppets bobbing on a wooden rail — a green frog, a pink diva, a warm-orange bear, and a blue oddball — each with wide white eyes, wandering pupils, and mouths that open and close as they sway, warm spotlights falling from above and dust motes drifting through the beams. On the right, a large cream SEPTEMBER 24, 2026 headline underlined by a green-magenta-orange sweep, a green JIM HENSON · 90 YEARS subhead, an italic pink MUPPETS · SESAME STREET · CREATURE SHOP tertiary, a dim FELT · FOAM · FOOLERY · HEART roster, and a Georgia-italic 'the most sophisticated people i know — inside they are all children.' caption at the base.

g.text: “life's like a movie, write your own ending.”
